hooks.command: py="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -f "$py" ] || py="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.venv/bin/python"; if [ ! -f "$py" ]; then echo "command_guard: no project virtual environment (.venv/Scripts/python.exe or .venv/bin/python); the command is blocked" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$py" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/command_guard.py"; code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ] && [ "$code" -ne 2 ]; then echo "command_guard could not run (exit $code): check .venv and .claude/hooks/command_guard.py; the command is blocked" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit $code
